title: Three level-ups
prompt: Same members and level_up as before. In `max_health_after_three`, call level_up three times. Then return max_health, which is 800.
starter:
var level = 1
var max_health = 100

func max_health_after_three():
	return max_health

func level_up():
	level += 1
	max_health *= 2

docs.name: a * b
docs.what: Multiplies two numbers. * with a float keeps decimals.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.

solution:
var level = 1
var max_health = 100

func max_health_after_three():
	level_up()
	level_up()
	level_up()
	return max_health

func level_up():
	level += 1
	max_health *= 2
